listing.name: SSX 3 (Xbox, PAL) (SSX3-recomp (koenhendriks))
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows package; Linux source build Limits: Windows player route and Linux x86-64 race boot documented upstream; Asahi ARM64 reaches menus only. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 release package. Linux x86-64 source build playable upstream; Linux ARM64 Asahi source build reaches menus only. Native macOS unsupported. Original data: Own PAL original Xbox SSX 3 dump, with default.xbe and complete data/ directory. Point the launcher at that extracted root; it checks PAL identity. This koenhendriks implementation is separate from bertibertig and PS2 versions. Exact accepted XBE hash/revision is not stated in the reviewed README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
